prompt: We publish our payments client as a small library built with Vite in library mode (installed; see vite.config.js). Our error reporter groups errors by `error.name`, and our logs print function names, but in the minified build `new PaymentError('x').name` and `chargeCard.name` come out as one-letter names. Change the build configuration so the built `dist/payments.js` keeps the original class and function names while staying minified. Do not change the source files.
